claim_ceiling: This benchmark proves only that REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry the fields the query_result_bundle contract needs (decision_id, canonical_url on mcp.opencaselaw.ch, language, citation strings, statutes, a frozen-marker-rule text surface) and that the ACCEPTED harness rejects a regressed bundle. It does NOT prove that Product builds such a bundle, that the map is useful to a jurist, that counter labels are calibrated (counter_uncertainty is a fixed fixture constant), that the coordinates are a good layout (they are a deterministic fixture layout, not a geometry claim), or anything about the absolute LABEL_SOUND / GEOMETRY_SOUND bars. Recall figures are measured, not thresholded. It does NOT demand legacy universal-174k science (removed from critical path). Zero-cost claims verified: 0 network calls, fixture mode, offline replay. Source-validity claims verified: canonical URLs on mcp.opencaselaw.ch.
evidence_summary: 24/24 raw OpenCaseLaw cache envelopes read and indexed; 0 network calls made (fixture mode, offline replay). 4/4 frozen questions produce source-linked, duplicate-free bundles with clickable map coordinates (x, y) and canonical URLs on mcp.opencaselaw.ch. leg1 pass: all 4 questions PASS — harness checks true on cached input. leg2 fired: all 4 questions — counter_classifications_supported correctly goes FALSE; 2/4 questions have zero counter candidates (published negative finding, counter-authority empty). leg3 fired: all 4 questions — source_urls_valid correctly goes FALSE when URL is repointed to example.invalid. 0 frozen benchmarks/pins/rubrics/thresholds weakened. 0 new candidates built or re-scored. 0 174k science demanded or rerun. 48/48 dedicated tests pass. Counter-authority yield properly disclosed: EMPTY for 2/4 frozen questions on cached input; negative result reported honestly, not spun as a pass.
claim_ceiling_brief: REAL cached OpenCaseLaw rows carry contract fields; accepted harness rejects regressed bundle; does NOT prove product builds bundle, map usefulness, counter calibration, coordinate geometry, or absolute bars. No 174k science demanded.
